minutes.headline: School Committee ratified three-year teacher and paraprofessional contracts and dropped the outdoor mask rule.
minutes.summary: The committee went into executive session on union negotiations, then honored retirees and approved the extended day and early learning center handbooks. It ratified the teachers' (LEA) and paraprofessionals' three-year agreements, heard a social studies curriculum presentation, and eliminated the outdoor mask requirement while keeping classroom cleaning. The business manager withdrew a math teacher posting because a new ESSER III award was announced and a spending plan needs community input.

what_happened.line: The School Committee ratified the three-year Lunenburg Educators Association (LEA) teacher contract by roll call, five yes including the town manager.
The committee accepted the three-year paraprofessional contract; Leighton abstained.
The committee eliminated the outdoor mask requirement and kept classroom cleaning protocols through the end of the school year; one member's vote was not clear in the captions.
Permission to post a mathematics teacher was withdrawn until a plan for a new ESSER III grant is developed, with a presentation set for June 16.
The committee accepted changes to the FY22 extended day and early learning center handbooks by roll call, four yes.

why_it_matters: The two ratified contracts set teacher and paraprofessional pay for three years, and the business manager described both as absorbable in the local budget, a claim the minutes do not show the working for.
The new ESSER III grant is outside-funded money with stricter reporting, so the spending plan decides whether positions it pays for are later carried by the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: June 16 meeting, in person at the middle high school multi-purpose room, where administration is to present the ESSER III spending plan.
A possible June 30 meeting to endorse the grant plan and approve positions.
